submitted.rationale: Index 3 (Mn 0.31) gave the highest measured photocurrent, 1.4e-7 A. Index 19 (Mn 0.35) gave 1.0e-7 A and index 14 (Mn 0.57) gave 5e-8 A. Photocurrent rises as the film gets more Sb-rich. XRD shows a single trirutile-like phase (peaks at Q 1.33 and 2.78) at Mn 0.35 to 0.41. At Mn 0.31 a secondary Sb-oxide phase appears alongside it, and it grows at Mn 0.23 and dominates at Mn 0.09. The mixed-phase point near the MnSb2O6 composition performed best.
